problem: Merge, CI or stale provider evidence can be mistaken for current production truth when main and provider identities move independently.
root_cause: Terminal status did not always force a fresh current-main plus provider-production identity binding at claim time.
prevention: Read current main immediately before LIVE_BEWEZEN.
Read current provider production commit_ref immediately before LIVE_BEWEZEN.
Require exact equality or Git ancestry containment for the delivered merge.
When main is ahead of provider production, remain non-terminal.
Keep autonomous follow-up owned by the delivery node through learning, skill and dashboard writeback.

evaluation.expected: LIVE_BEWEZEN is possible only with fresh repository/provider binding and terminal writeback.
